==Mythos Source==
Miskatonic University appears frequently in H.P. Lovecraft's work.  It is first mentioned in ''Herbert West-—Reanimator'' (1921).  Other notable references include ''The Dunwich Horror'' (1929), ''The Dreams in the Witch-house'' (1933), and ''The Shadow Out of Time'' (1936).
